name: leave
note: N5a: on_leave. Three plots in a row, 100 m apart; the plot entries override the packs' own on_leave. a (pause): holds while the player is away, goes on when he is back. b (end): its run ends when he leaves; when he returns it is built again from its seed. c (bot, the default): plays on. The player visits a, b, a, b.
